blogs.title: Eng. Fadi Abdullah… A Young Real Estate Leader Leaving a Strong Mark on the Egyptian Property Market.
blogs.content: Eng. Fadi Abdullah… A Young Real Estate Leader Leaving a Strong Mark on the Egyptian Property Market Eng. Fadi Abdullah… The Engineer Continuing to Build the Legacy of “Urbnlanes” Eng. Fadi Abdullah… A Young Real Estate Expert Holding the Keys to a Kuwaiti “Property Giant” Eng. Fadi Abdullah… A Model of Entrepreneurship and a Distinguished Real Estate Journey Eng. Fadi Abdullah, CEO of Urbnlanes Kuwait, is considered a prime example of a new generation of real estate developers who have managed to leave a significant mark on the Egyptian property market. Under his leadership, the company launched six projects within just three years, with total investments approaching EGP 46 billion. Although Eng. Fadi Abdullah is only 32 years old, he possesses extensive experience, having entered the workforce early. In addition to his role at Urbnlanes Kuwait, he serves on the boards of Emil Abdullah Investments, a prominent company with a strong project portfolio in Kuwait, First Group for General Trading and Contracting, and chairs First Ads for Advertising and Public Relations. Born in Kuwait City, Eng. Fadi Abdullah earned a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from the American University in Cairo, specializing in project management. This laid a solid foundation for his professional career. He subsequently joined Emil Abdullah Investments, the distinguished family business comprising six other companies. In 2011, he became CEO of First United Egypt, successfully overseeing diverse projects in Egypt, focusing on developing prime locations such as Maadi, Sheraton, and New Cairo. A Distinguished Track Record in Kuwait Eng. Fadi played a vital role in supervising the company’s extensive operations in Kuwait, leaving a strong mark through his own projects, including American University of the Middle East, West Abdullah Mubarak City, Muttlaa City, and Hessa Mubarak Towers—all reflecting his dedicated and outstanding leadership. Under his leadership, First Group Kuwait successfully delivered over 100 projects, including 20 skyscrapers and three major cities, earning widespread recognition, including three ISO certificates in 2017. Driven by a passion for innovation and a commitment to shaping Egypt’s urban landscape, Fadi Abdullah founded Urbnlanes Real Estate Development with an initial investment of EGP 11 billion. With a vision to redefine the real estate sector and create landmark architectural developments, Urbnlanes Kuwait began a transformative journey with the launch of its inaugural project, Levels Business Tower in the New Administrative Capital. Under Eng. Fadi Abdullah’s leadership, Urbnlanes positioned itself as a leader in luxury real estate development, relying on meticulous planning, consistent quality standards, and fostering exclusive communities and clientele within its projects. The results under his vision speak for themselves. The company’s second project, Eastlane, sold out completely within four hours, demonstrating the market’s confidence in his unique vision. This success was repeated with the first, second, and third phases of NOI Residence, Urbnlanes’ latest residential project in New Cairo, sold within 24 hours, underscoring the company’s commitment to excellence in quality, maintenance, and delivery schedules. Urbnlanes Sales… Huge Figures in Record Time Eng. Fadi Abdullah enhanced the company’s project portfolio through partnerships with leading international engineering firms, including WSA Dubai, Tahseen Consulting, Raef Fahmy Consulting, and Hany Saad Innovation Office, alongside strategic collaborations with industry leaders such as Allianz, Etisalat Misr, Savills, Enova by Veolia, Jadar, and Regus, providing the highest-quality services to clients. According to Eng. Fadi Abdullah, the projects launched in Egypt so far are only the beginning. The company aims to expand to coastal cities, considering investments in the North Coast and other opportunities in Egypt, with a firm commitment to excellence and shaping the urban landscape. The goal is to extend Urbnlanes Kuwait into coastal cities and residential complexes, ushering in a new era of innovation and prosperity. Under the leadership of Emil Abdullah and the collaboration between Eng. Fadi Abdullah, Eng. Shady Abdullah, and Eng. Mina Abdullah, the group achieved unprecedented expansion, with plans extending to Saudi Arabia, where two projects have been successfully delivered. The group also targets further expansion in Dubai, Greece, and other international markets.

blogs.title: Eng. Mina Abdullah… A Pioneer of Innovation, Quality, and Sustainability at First Group Kuwait & Saudi Arabia.
blogs.content: Eng. Mina Emil Abdullah: A Visionary Leader Driving Real Estate Excellence Eng. Mina Emil Abdullah, CEO of First Group Kuwait and Board Member of Urbnlanes Kuwait, believes that true success is built on clear vision, determination, and teamwork—principles that have made the projects he has managed within the Emil Abdullah Group models of quality and innovation across the Arab world. Eng. Mina has demonstrated that success in leadership knows no age limits. He has taken on numerous executive responsibilities that contributed to the expansion of the Group's operations and the establishment of several subsidiaries both in Egypt and abroad. He graduated from the Department of Civil Engineering at the American University in Cairo (AUC) in 2014 and quickly embarked on his professional journey within the Emil Abdullah Investment Group, taking on key leadership roles that supported the Group's growth and the creation of new companies in Egypt and internationally. Currently, Eng. Mina serves as CEO of the following companies: First Group, Urbnlanes Developments, Advertising First, Emil Abdullah Investments, First United Masr, Solo, and White Pearl. He is also a Board Member of Urbnlanes Kuwait, one of the leading real estate development companies in Kuwait and Egypt, recognized for its premium projects that combine contemporary design with high quality, establishing it as a prominent brand in both the Egyptian and Gulf markets. A Successful Career Journey Over 11 years, Eng. Mina has held diverse positions within the Emil Abdullah Group, demonstrating a pragmatic approach to market adaptation, innovation, and anticipating changes in the sectors where the Group operates. He emphasizes that continuous development is the key to sustainable, long-term success. By integrating the latest technologies and adopting new ideas, development becomes a key driver of excellence. This philosophy guides Eng. Mina, who believes that embracing innovation at every stage of real estate development distinguishes successful projects, delivers advanced solutions that meet client expectations, ensures sustainability and efficiency, and secures a prestigious position in highly competitive and ever-changing real estate markets. Advanced Management Throughout his career, Eng. Mina has led major real estate projects and towers, raising the standards of quality and planning in the regional property market. He has also strengthened the position of the companies he manages by implementing advanced management systems and global performance standards, delivering innovative projects that meet the growing needs and aspirations of clients. First Group boasts an extensive portfolio of distinguished projects, including over 100 projects, 4 residential cities, and 20 towers—each representing a unique real estate development experience that positions the Group among landmark developments. These achievements reflect the Group's exceptional operational, technical, and execution capabilities, with Eng. Mina Emil Abdullah at the forefront. Many of the projects managed by Eng. Mina have received ISO certification in recognition of their commitment to quality and integrated management. He has also been awarded three prestigious international real estate and management awards, the latest in Saudi Arabia, honoring his outstanding achievements and contributions to the Gulf real estate sector. Eng. Mina's award in Saudi Arabia was the result of First Group KSA's landmark projects, including Al-Nahda Mosque and municipal headquarters in Sulai and Namar, Riyadh, which he supervised. Through these projects, Eng. Mina transferred decades of the Group's design and execution expertise to Saudi Arabia, contributing to the Kingdom's current urban development.

blogs.title: From Kuwait to Egypt | First Group and Urbnlanes… A Unique Development Vision and Modern Communities with a Distinctive Touch.
blogs.content: First Group has maintained its leading position in the Gulf real estate and construction sector over a journey spanning more than 38 years. Founded in Kuwait in 1987 by entrepreneur Emil Abdullah, the company established a comprehensive development vision to rebuild urban infrastructure in the post-war era, laying a solid foundation of quality, commitment, and excellence in real estate development. Since its inception, First Group has adopted a fully integrated operational model encompassing all stages of real estate development—from design and construction to technical management. This approach has allowed the company to maintain full control over quality standards and delivery schedules, making it one of the most trusted names in Kuwait and the region. Over the years, the company has completed more than 100 major projects, including 20 high-rise towers exceeding 44 floors and four integrated cities. First Group holds a top-tier classification in construction in Kuwait and is among the top three developers specializing in commercial and administrative towers in the Gulf. It has also earned six ISO international certifications in recognition of its adherence to the highest standards of quality, management, and safety. Projects That Build Trust First Group has successfully executed major strategic projects, including: Levels Tower, Hessa Al Mubarak Tower, Panasonic Tower, Anjazat Tower, Melaa City, Sabah Al-Ahmad City, and American University of Kuwait (AUM) – the largest American university in the Middle East. The company's portfolio spans governmental, medical, educational, and commercial projects, earning it a reputation for trust, structural strength, and engineering precision. Urbnlanes Kuwait: The Egyptian Extension of Leading Gulf Expertise Urbnlanes Developments, the real estate arm of Emeel Abdalla Investments in Egypt, represents a Kuwaiti company with a modern Egyptian vision. Since entering the Egyptian market, Urbnlanes has established itself among the top players in one of the region's most competitive markets, thanks to its unique build before sell strategy and full confidence in the quality of its real estate products. Urbnlanes leverages operational expertise from First Group while applying Gulf-standard practices in construction and management. It possesses a fully integrated equipment portfolio and large supply capabilities, ensuring consistent quality and durability across all projects. The company's investments in Egypt exceed EGP 50 billion, with a record of delivering projects ahead of schedule, establishing Urbnlanes as a leading name in both the New Administrative Capital and New Cairo. A Distinctive Presence in New Cairo and the Administrative Capital To date, the company has launched six major projects, marking milestones in the Egyptian real estate market. These projects combine modern design, high-quality execution, and strategic prime locations: NOI Residence – Egypt's First Tropical Community Located in Golden Square, Fifth Settlement, on 46 acres, the project features a nature-inspired design based on the Voronoi philosophy. Ökoplan handled master planning, Hany Saad designed the landscape, and Jadar provided integrated management. Amenities include walking and cycling paths, natural lakes, a luxury clubhouse, tennis and paddle courts, a full wellness center, and a luxury hotel operated by Story Hospitality (Abu Dhabi Capital), aligning with Egypt's plan to double hotel capacity by 2028 and reach 30 million tourists by 2030. Midlane – Modern Business Hub in Fifth Settlement Located at North 90th Street and Mohamed Naguib Axis, covering 15,000 m² with a total built-up area of 85,000 m². It includes commercial, medical, and administrative spaces fully equipped with integrated work-leisure experiences and advanced hotel and office services. Delivered in two phases over 1–4 years. Levels Business Tower – A New Administrative Capital Icon One of the tallest towers in the Downtown area, 41 floors with 15,000 m², overlooking the Green River and North Mohamed bin Zayed Axis. The tower includes commercial, administrative, and hotel areas managed by Crowne Plaza, with a pedestrian bridge connecting the Green River to the business district—a unique feature among tourist towers. Design partners include Ökoplan, Mohamed Hafez Consultancy, Jadar, WSA, and e&. Yellow Residence – Balanced Lifestyle in New Cairo Located on Cairo-Suez Road, 100,800 m², with a 35% construction ratio. It includes residential and hotel apartments (Crown Residence), offices, clinics, a hospital, a hotel, shops, and restaurants. All units sold within 24 hours. Designers include WSA, Hafez Consultants, and Ökoplan. Yellow Lane – Integrated Work and Living Located on Cairo-Suez Road, 24 acres, featuring 16 administrative buildings, 3 clinic buildings, a hospital, hotel, serviced apartments, and commercial rental areas. Façade: 700 m, 15% construction ratio. Design by Tahseen Amin, consulting by Hafez Consultants. Delivered over 3 years. Eastlane Mall – Integrated Retail and Living Experience Located on South 90th Street, Fifth Settlement, combining shopping, dining, and modern lifestyle. All administrative units sold within 4 hours and delivered ahead of schedule. Includes shops, cafés, restaurants, supermarket, and offices, offering a premium development environment blending comfort, functionality, and quality. Leaders of Vision and Innovation The expansion and leadership journey is driven by Emil Abdullah, alongside his sons: Eng. Fadi Abdullah, CEO of Urbnlanes Kuwait, Eng. Shady Abdullah, CEO of Urbnlanes (jointly), and Eng. Mina Abdullah, CEO of First Group and Board Member of Urbnlanes Kuwait. Their combined expertise and oversight of architectural design, planning, aesthetics, and functionality ensure that each Urbnlanes project carries a distinctive architectural identity, reinforcing the group's position among the leading Gulf development companies.

blogs.title: IHG completes dual signing for Crowne Plaza hotels in Egypt.
blogs.content: The signings will see the introduction of the Crowne Plaza Cairo New Administrative Capital and the Crowne Plaza New Cairo Yellow. Set to open in 2028, the Crowne Plaza Cairo New Administrative Capital will offer three dining options, including a sky bar, and five meeting venues to cater to the needs of corporate guests. The location offers accessibility to business guests looking for proximity to the nearby government ministries, administrative institutions, embassies and finance houses in Cairo. The Crowne Plaza New Cairo Yellow will be part of a mixed-use development project a short distance from business parks and Cairo International Airport. Along with an all-day dining restaurant and a Club Lounge, the hotel will feature five meeting and events venues including a ballroom.

blogs.title: Urbnlanes Developments & IHG Hotels & Resorts Forge Groundbreaking Partnership to Launch Two Prestigious “Crowne Plaza” in Its Projects in New Cairo and NAC.
content: Urbnlanes Developments, a leading player in the real estate development and a subsidiary Emeel Abdalla Investments, has announced a strategic partnership with IHG Hotels & Resorts, one of the world’s leading hotel companies. This partnership aims to open two new hotels under the globally recognized brand “Crowne Plaza” in Yellow Residence New Cairo and Levels Business Tower NAC. Representing investments exceeding three and a half billion EGP, these hotels signify a significant milestone in both the hospitality and real estate sectors, promising an exceptional experience that combines the luxury and comfort associated with Crowne Plaza with Urbnlanes’ expertise in developing distinctive real estate projects.

Provided by Urbnlanes The signing ceremony was attended by notable figures including Ghada Shalaby, Deputy Minister of Tourism and Antiquities, H.E. Ghanem Saqr, the Ambassador of the State of Kuwait to Cairo, and Khaled Abbas, Chairman of New Administrative Capital. The agreement was signed by Eng. Emeel Abdallah, Chairman of Urbnlanes Developments, and Haitham Mattar, Managing Director, India, Middle East & Africa, IHG, in the presence of Eng. Fadi Emeel Abdalla, CEO of Urbnlanes, Eng. Shadi Emeel Abdalla, Managing Director of Urbnlanes, and leaders from the Ministry of Tourism, reflecting the strength of this partnership and its impact on the tourism sector in Egypt, by enhancing luxurious hospitality experiences and attracting more visitors from around the world.

Provided by Urbnlanes As part of this partnership, two hotels will be established. The first is the Crowne Plaza New Cairo, located within the Yellow Residence mixed-use project, situated in the heart of New Cairo on the Suez Road directly adjacent to Rehab City. The second is the Crowne Plaza Levels Tower in the New Administrative Capital within the Levels Business Tower project, located on the frontline of tourist towers in the Downtown area of the New Administrative Capital directly on the Green River. These prime locations ensure guests a sophisticated stay featuring modern amenities and exceptional services. The hotels will provide unique levels of comfort and luxury, ensuring guests the highest levels of flexibility and balance between work requirements and enjoying an atmosphere of tranquility and relaxation. This makes them an ideal destination for travelers from around the world, enhancing Egypt’s position as a global tourist destination and contributing to attracting more tourists and foreign investments to the hospitality sector.

Provided by Urbnlanes Set to open in 2028, The upcoming opening of the two new hotels demonstrate a commitment to the highest standards of quality. The Crowne Plaza New Cairo Yellow Residence boasts a prime location near business hubs and Cairo International Airport, offering 180 rooms, a 24/7 restaurant, a Club Lounge, and five meeting rooms along with an events hall and banquet facilities.

Provided by Urbnlanes Similarly, the Crowne Plaza New Administrative Capital, part of the Levels Business Tower project, provides 110 rooms tailored for business travelers, ensuring convenient access to government ministries, administrative institutions, and embassies. The hotel features three upscale restaurants and five meeting rooms equipped to cater to guests’ needs.

blogs.title: PHASE 1 OF LUXURIOUS ‘YELLOW RESIDENCE’ BY URBNLANES SOLD OUT FOR EGP 1.2 BILLION.
content: As the sprawling metropolis of Cairo grows ever outwards, so too do opportunities for new expressions of urban life. Imagine luxuriating in a modern apartment – built out of tall panes of glass overlooking verdant gardens, and facades of eco-friendly wood and concrete integrated seamlessly with the trees and natural flora that brings a fresh sense of life to your everyday routine. This is what it’s like to live in Yellow Residence, a grand project by Kuwaiti company @Urbnlanes, which has sold out all of their Phase 1 units for EGP 1.2 billion.

Spread across 100,000 square metres, Yellow Residence boasts a collection of spacious units, meticulously designed to cater to the discerning tastes of its residents. From one, two and three-room apartments, duplexes, and penthouses, each dwelling harmoniously blends nature with cutting-edge technology. 95% of the units offer breathtaking views of sprawling green spaces and meandering water features, providing a serene oasis for relaxation and tranquillity. Connecting directly with nature is made possible as trees weave through the central buildings’ vertical gardens, adding a touch of green to the urban landscape.

Nestled near the old Suez Road, residents enjoy effortless access to the airport, Al Rehab City, The American University in Cairo, Madinaty, and the New Administrative Capital. At the helm of this visionary project is Egyptian entrepreneur Eng. Fadi Abdalla, acting as Urbnlanes’ CEO. Eng. Abdalla’s extensive experience in constructing mixed-use projects in Maadi, Sheraton and New Cairo – along with the expertise of their sister Kuwaiti company, First Group, which has built over 20 high-rise buildings, three cities, and over 100 projects – have paved the way for Yellow Residence’s living experience.

Yellow Residence stands testament to Urbnlanes’ dedication to creating unparalleled living spaces. But this is just the beginning for Urbnlanes as they continue to invest in the Egyptian market, with more residential mega-projects, commercial developments, and administrative ventures on the horizon.

blogs.title: NEW CAIRO’S DESTINATION FOR LUXURY BRANDS ‘EASTLANE BY URBNLANES DEVELOPMENTS’ SELLS OUT ALL ITS OFFICES JUST FOUR HOURS AFTER LAUNCH.
content: EASTLANE – an ultra-modern, mixed-use commercial project set to open in the heart of New Cairo – has sold out all of its administrative offices just four hours after real estate company Urbnlanes Developments, a member of Egyptian-Kuwaiti developers Emeel Abdalla Investments, made them officially available to the public. The sales are estimated to add up to EGP 700 million.

Strategically situated on the last distinctive plot of land in the Fifth Settlement overlooking South 90th Street in front of Concord Plaza, EASTLANE promises to shake up the neighbourhood with its luxurious fine dining destinations and a selection of premium shops. Its accessible location near American University in Egypt, Deutsch Haus and Waterway II could explain why EASTLANE is already in such high demand, alongside its stylish design by Eng. Raef Fahmi – the same name behind some of Egypt’s most dashing destinations like 5A by the Waterway.

Managed by renowned facility management giant ENOVA, and branded by Longeblack, EASTLANE promises to house a community of up-and-coming entrepreneurs. EASTLANE is Urbnlanes’ second project in Egypt, with an investment of 2 billion EGP, out of an initial investment that reached up to 11 billion EGP. This new launch comes six months after the successful launch of Urbnlanes’ first project in Egypt, LEVELS TOWER.
